## Details

<a id="text_chars_2000"></a>
### [`text_chars_2000`](../../../../src/data/text_charset.asm#L6) `$5000-$50FF`

*data*

Multicolour characters $00-$75. The set-up copies $5000-$53ff to the character set at $2000. Digits are $10-$19 plus $44-$4d, letters $21-$3a plus $55-$6e.

- **Read by:** [`init_screens`](../init/init_screens.md#init_screens)
